trivy.note: Malicious release published 2026-03-19 during the Trivy supply chain compromise. Treat any host or pipeline that ran it as compromised and rotate credentials.
Malicious container image tags pushed to Docker Hub on 2026-03-22 with no matching GitHub release.

actions.note: 76 of 77 tags were force-pushed to malicious commits on 2026-03-19. Use 0.35.0 or later, pinned by SHA.
All tags before the recreated 0.2.6 were replaced with malicious commits. Use 0.2.6 or later, pinned by SHA.
